manual_name: Introduction To OpendTect and OpendTect Pro Training Manual 7.0
manual_reference: 1.4.3b Fault Sticks, steps 5–17 (steps 1–4, loading In-line 110 and zooming to the faulted part, are the initial state; step 18 'repeat for more planes' is out of scope)
goal: F3 Demo의 In-line 110(4 Dip steered median filter)에서 새 FaultStickSet을 만들어 FaultStickSet_01로 저장하고 Only at Sections로 표시한 뒤, 인라인 110·120 …에서 fault stick을 픽하고, Z-slice 1500 ms에 9-1 Similarity를 표시해 같은 lineament의 스틱을 선택한 다음 Copy Selection to > Fault > Create Single New로 단층면 Fault_01A를 만든다. 매뉴얼 §1.4.3b.

initial_state.description: F3 Demo survey 활성. In-line 110에 4 Dip steered median filter 표시(Add Default Data), In-line view, 단층 부위로 표시 영역 축소. FaultStickSet 트리 항목 비어 있음.
must_be_true: In-line 110 displayed with '4 Dip steered median filter'
no FaultStickSet item in the tree

_study2_note: Authored from the manual text only (2026-09-21), before any screenshot was captured. visual_state_gt is filled after capture by gt_enumerate_visible_elements.py + external review; patterns/keywords are NOT changed after the screenshots or any model output are seen.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Main window, In-line 110 with '4 Dip steered median filter' in In-line view, zoomed to the faulted part (manual steps 1–4). Tree: FaultStickSet item EMPTY. No dialog, no context menu.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Set the inline to 110, clicked View In-line and resized the display to the faulted area.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Tree shows '<New FaultStickSet 1>' under FaultStickSet. In-line 110 still displayed. No dialog open, no context menu.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Right-clicked FaultStickSet > New (manual step 5) and closed the menu.

capture_instructions.screen_state: 'Output selection' dialog open (from Save as...): field 'Output FaultStickSet' EMPTY or default, Select..., 'Replace in tree' checkbox, OK / Cancel / Help buttons.
must_not_show: FaultStickSet_01 already typed in the field

capture_instructions.screen_state: Dialog closed. Tree item now reads 'FaultStickSet_01'. In-line 110 displayed. Only at Sections NOT yet enabled; no context menu open.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Typed FaultStickSet_01 and clicked OK (manual step 7).

allowed_alternatives.note: Enabling the pick prerequisites (manual step 10 note) is a valid next action if not yet visibly on.

capture_instructions.screen_state: FaultStickSet_01 selected in the tree, Display > Only at Sections ON, Position mode active, Edit Sticks icon toggled on. In-line 110 displayed. NO fault stick picked yet.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Enabled Only at Sections (manual step 8) and made the set active for picking.
must_not_show: any fault stick on the section

capture_instructions.screen_state: In-line 110 with SEVERAL fault sticks drawn along the fault(s). FaultStickSet_01 in tree. Still on inline 110 (navigation toolbar shows 110). No Z-slice.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Picked several fault sticks on inline 110 (manual steps 9–12).

capture_instructions.screen_state: Fault sticks now exist on several inlines (110, 120, 130 …); current inline is NOT 110 (e.g. 130 or 140 in the toolbar). FaultStickSet_01 in tree. NO Z-slice yet.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Moved through inlines with Z/X (step 10) picking sticks on each (manual step 13).

capture_instructions.screen_state: Z-slice at 1500 ms in the tree with '9-1 Similarity on FEF seismic' displayed; view from the top (View North); the fault sticks are visible over the similarity slice, all UNSELECTED (violet). Copy Selection toolbar not used yet.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Added an empty Z-slice, dragged it to 1500 ms, clicked View North and added the 9-1 Similarity stored attribute (manual steps 14–15).

allowed_alternatives.note: Ground-truth element mention for the grounding validator.

capture_instructions.screen_state: GOAL-REACHED terminal state: 'Fault_01A' present under Fault in the tree and the fault plane visible in the scene. Copy Selection toolbar closed/idle. No dialog open.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Selected the sticks of one lineament, chose Copy Selection to > Fault > Create Single New, typed Fault_01A and clicked Go! (manual steps 16–17).

completion.note: step_8 depicts the goal-achieved terminal state (Fault_01A created from the selected sticks). Creating further planes (manual step 18) is out of scope.
